item.title: U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services, August 2026
item.description: The U.S. goods and services trade deficit was $61.2 billion in August, down $3.4 billion from $64.6 billion in July. Exports were $280.1 billion and imports were $341.3 billion.

item.title: Gross Domestic Product, 2nd Quarter 2026 (Third Estimate)
item.description: Real gross domestic product increased at an annual rate of 2.2 percent in the second quarter of 2026, according to the third estimate. In the first quarter, real GDP increased 1.8 percent.

item.title: Personal Income and Outlays, June 2026
item.description: Personal income increased 0.3 percent in June. This release is older than the 30-day window and must be dropped.
